q1_issues.issue: "the U.S. ... administrator" fuses a proper-noun premodifier into u_s_administrator, which Names and casing forbids (names sit outside Compound concepts): the licensed route types the head noun on its own and links it with (Possession ... us), and the mandatory (Name ... "U.S.") fact is missing.

q2_gaps: discourse-level "Meanwhile" (simultaneity with a prior, out-of-sentence event) has no licensed carrier - it is correctly left out, but no gap-recording form exists

support-verb plus event-noun object ("paid a two-hour visit to ..."): the light-verb rule names only occur / happen / take place and does not say how the subject's role or the "to"-destination attach to the noun-borne eventuality
notes: The definite plural is handled well - group witness with named members linked by PartOf, "northern" distributed to each member rather than predicated of the group symbol - and the appositive typing correctly takes the past host clause's wrapper. Splitting "civilian" off as a property of Bremer while fusing "U.S." into the compound treats two modifiers of one NP inconsistently, though the split itself is defensible.
